title: LCSD says City Ticketing system illegally accessed by hackers, preliminarily about 130萬 users’ data may be involved
date_note: RTHK's article of 25 November gives no earlier day for LCSD's announcement; the contractor reported the breach to LCSD the previous day, per RTHK.
summary: Hong Kong’s Leisure and Cultural Services Department (LCSD) said the City Ticketing system was illegally accessed by hackers; RTHK’s headline gives a preliminary figure of about 130萬 users’ data. The data includes usernames, names, phone numbers and email addresses. LCSD says the system does not store identity document details and credit card information is masked, and it reported the case to police and regulators.
plain: Hong Kong’s LCSD says its City Ticketing system was illegally accessed. A preliminary figure of about 130萬 users’ names and contact details may be involved, per RTHK.
exec: A Hong Kong ticketing system was breached; preliminarily about 130萬 users’ data may be involved, per RTHK.
geo_basis: LCSD, the Hong Kong government department that announced it; no city-level victim location stated
org: Leisure and Cultural Services Department (Hong Kong)

evidence.quote: 康文署：城市售票網被黑客非法進入 初步涉約130萬使用者資料

validation.note: Only RTHK read, relaying LCSD's statement; LCSD's own notice not found.
